conditions.name: baseline
conditions.description: all four course files, default settings, no course intent, no lecturer rules

conditions.name: no_transcript
conditions.description: lecture transcript left out (no check of delivered against planned)

conditions.name: with_intent
conditions.description: course intent stated: analyse and evaluate levels expected

intent.goals: Students should be able to analyse and evaluate algorithms, not only describe them.

conditions.name: with_rule

constraints: Keep exercises short and tied to one lecture.

conditions.name: no_auto_drafts
conditions.description: automatic drafts after the audit switched off

conditions.name: no_gate_retries
conditions.description: Stakeholder gate may not ask for a second attempt
